title: Fixed-floor smooth Class-II null-branch dichotomy
question: For the fixed-floor three-component Class-II current, what is the exact smooth-field pathwise zero-energy set, and does it split into a pure-singlet branch and an active-doublet constant-density phase branch without identifying it with the conditional contraction W_eps zero set?
purpose: Advance the open A6 full-field bare-concentration gate by classifying the pathwise null branches of the already fixed functional. This is an additive exact local/connected-domain lemma; it does not alter the A6/A7 functional, the T-054 owner order, or the T-059/T-061 inverse lane.

exact_scope.domain: connected C1 spatial domain; the intended application is the connected periodic three-torus
exact_scope.generators: the three embedded Pauli matrices acting on z
exact_scope.floor: epsilon_rho>0, so rho+epsilon_rho is strictly positive
exact_scope.currents: m_A=z^dagger sigma_A z, q_A=m_A/(rho+epsilon_rho), J_A=grad m_A, K_A=J_A-q_A grad rho
exact_scope.energy: e_II=(1/2) sum_A [a|J_A|^2+2b J_A dot K_A+c|K_A|^2] with a>0 and ac-b^2>0
exact_scope.limit_order: none; exact pathwise null-set classification only
exact_scope.quantum_status: no Hilbert-space, Gibbs, operator-domain, continuum, or thermodynamic statement

theorem.positive_form: Positive definiteness of [[a,b],[b,c]] makes e_II=0 equivalent to J_A=K_A=0 for every A and spatial direction.
theorem.dichotomy: On a connected domain, a smooth pathwise null field is either z identically zero, with arbitrary singlet field psi_3, or has a nonzero constant Bloch vector, constant total rho, and a constant doublet rank-one projector; only its local U(1) phase and the singlet phase may vary.
theorem.converse: Both the pure-singlet branch and the constant-Bloch/constant-rho phase branch give J_A=K_A=0 and hence e_II=0.
theorem.conditional_mean_firewall: An active-doublet phase plane wave can have e_II=0 while W_eps(Psi)>0, so the conditional contraction zero set is strictly not the pathwise null set.

proof_skeleton: Use a>0 and ac-b^2>0 to complete the two-variable coefficient form as (a*j+b*k)^2/a+(ac-b^2)k^2/a.
A nonnegative continuous density with zero integral is pointwise zero; the positive form therefore gives J_A=K_A=0.
J_A=0 on a connected domain makes every m_A constant.
The Bloch identity makes a zero constant Bloch vector equivalent to z=0 everywhere.
If the constant Bloch vector is nonzero, at least one q_A is nowhere zero because of the positive floor; K_A=0 and J_A=0 then force grad rho=0.
The Pauli reconstruction z z^dagger=(s I+m dot sigma)/2 gives a constant doublet projector; converses are direct.
assumptions: The A6/A7 Pauli current definitions and the fixed positive rho floor are the controlling functional definitions.
The coefficient matrix is positive definite; the concrete production coefficients are derived from the A1 manifest rather than inserted in the proof script.
The spatial domain is connected and the field is C1, so zero gradients imply constant scalar moments and zero integral of a continuous nonnegative density implies pointwise zero.
The Pauli Bloch reconstruction is used only for the first two complex components.
Lean checks the exact rational algebraic core; the calculus and connected-domain steps remain explicit analytic assumptions of this T0 package.
missing_assumptions: Tube-probability and entropy estimates for every null branch under the spatially correlated finite-cutoff Gibbs law.
A cutoff-uniform partition-function/tightness argument and a classification of subsequential bare measures.
A renormalisation prescription, floor removal, infinite-volume limit, or physical branch selection.
A source-owned Q3LOCK production dynamics, common alpha, QFT correspondence, Yang--Mills identity, or mass-gap bridge.

adversarial_review.check: Could a zero quadratic energy occur with nonzero J or K?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: primary, independent and Lean lanes require a>0 and ac-b^2>0 and reject a null nonzero pair.

adversarial_review.check: Could m_A=0 allow a nonzero first doublet?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: the exact Bloch identity and zero-sum-of-squares implication force z=0.

adversarial_review.check: Could q_A vanish in the nonzero-Bloch branch because rho is singular?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: epsilon_rho>0 makes the denominator strictly positive; a nonzero constant m_A gives nonzero q_A.

adversarial_review.check: Does constant rho alone imply a null field?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: the active branch also requires constant Bloch moments/projector; a rotating doublet is a hostile counterexample.

adversarial_review.check: Can W_eps^{-1}(0) replace the pathwise null set?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: an active-doublet common-phase plane wave has zero pathwise energy but positive W_eps.

adversarial_review.check: Does this classification replace the existing A6/A7 or T-054 methods?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: it is an additive pathwise lemma under the existing fixed functional and owner order.

evidence_level: T0 exact analytic null-branch dichotomy with executable algebraic and adversarial cross-checks; not a Gibbs or continuum theorem
non_claims: This result does not prove that finite-cutoff Gibbs measures concentrate on any one branch.
It does not provide branch tube probabilities, entropy costs, partition convergence, tightness, or a nontrivial bare subsequential limit.
It does not select the pure-singlet branch or identify an active phase branch with Reading-H physical empty space.
It does not close A6 counterterm closure, A7 self-coupling/Nelson, Pre-A, Sector A, QFT, Yang--Mills, gravity, continuum, or mass gap.
The established A6/A7 functional, T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 inverse method and owner order are unchanged.
boundary: R-461 classifies the smooth pathwise fixed-floor null branches of the displayed Class-II current. It is not a classification of the finite-cutoff Gibbs measure and supplies no entropy, partition, tightness, regulator-removal, continuum, physical-sector or QFT result.
next_action: Use the two-branch classification as the required input partition for a future A6 branch-aware tube/entropy audit. Until a cutoff-uniform branch probability and tightness estimate is proved, do not infer pure-third concentration or close the A6/A7 gates. Continue unchanged T-054 Q3LOCK owner intake and keep T-059/T-061 observation-source locks.
